title: Documenting Trofinetide Treatment Phenotypes in Rett Syndrome with a Dual-LLM Consensus Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2610.22062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Trofinetide, approved in 2023 as the first Rett syndrome treatment, lacks scalable real-world monitoring because chart review is labor-intensive. We developed a dual large language model (LLM) consensus pipeline to extract 18 treatment-response phenotypes, comprising 4 adverse effects, 13 Rett clinical features, and medication refusal, from clinical notes. Materials and Methods: We analyzed 26,763 notes from 108 patients with confirmed sustained trofinetide exposure at Texas Children's Hospital. The pipeline filters notes by keyword, classifies each through two LLMs requiring consensus, and aggregates a patient-by-timepoint matrix. Architecture and prompt were selected on a diarrhea development set, then frozen and applied to the other 17 phenotypes with the phenotype definition substituted, as an out-of-sample test. The reported prompt comparison scores 183 expert-labeled cells. Results: A prompt requiring diarrhea to be ac

translated_title: 利用双大语言模型共识流水线记录雷特综合征曲非奈肽治疗表型
translated_abstract: 目的：曲非奈肽于2023年获批，是首个用于治疗雷特综合征的药物，但由于人工病历审查耗时费力，目前缺乏可扩展的真实世界监测手段。我们开发了一个双大语言模型（LLM）共识流水线，用于从临床笔记中提取18种治疗反应表型，包括4种不良反应、13种雷特综合征临床特征以及拒药行为。材料与方法：我们分析了德克萨斯儿童医院108名确认持续使用曲非奈肽的患者的26,763份临床笔记。该流水线先通过关键词过滤笔记，再由两个大语言模型分类并要求二者达成共识，最后汇总生成患者-时间点矩阵。模型架构和提示词在腹泻开发集上选定后即被冻结，随后通过替换表型定义将其应用于其余17种表型，作为样本外测试。报告中比较的提示词基于183个专家标注的单元格进行评分。结果：要求腹泻必须为急性的提示词……
tldr: 该研究开发了一种双大语言模型共识流水线，能从临床笔记中自动提取雷特综合征患者曲非奈肽治疗的18种反应表型，为首个获批的雷特综合征治疗药物提供了可扩展的真实世界监测方案。
en_tdlr: This study developed a dual-LLM consensus pipeline that automatically extracts 18 trofinetide treatment-response phenotypes from clinical notes, enabling scalable real-world monitoring of the first approved treatment for Rett syndrome.
